title: Federation onboarding external probe discards the bounded-read error, so an intermittent Unavailable cannot be diagnosed
outcome: When an external onboarding probe's bounded read fails, the adapter keeps the exact error, its stage and its timing in its result and diagnostics instead of collapsing it to a bare Unavailable, so intermittent failures can be attributed.
acceptance: The federation onboarding external adapter retains the bounded-read Err (kind, stage: spawn, wait, read or pipe, and elapsed time) in its diagnostic output when it reports Unavailable.

The root cause of the intermittent second-call Unavailable, seen on local cmd.exe stubs 5 ms after a successful first call, is identified from that retained detail and fixed or filed, with no timeout inflation or retry.
The existing federation_onboarding_external tests keep all assertions.
